time_axis: Raw M5 time_open_unix/time_close_unix are MT5_PY_API_UNIX_SECONDS but timezone_status is UNRESOLVED_REQUIRES_MANUAL_BINDING; project time-axis policy treats raw timestamps as broker-clock alignment keys until mapped.
sample_scope: US100 M5 raw rows 261345; fwd12/model-input rows 46650; F85 selected readout rows 4127; no tick/M1 source payload registered.

feature_label_boundary.features_allowed: Closed-bar pre-entry features and entry-known source state only.
feature_label_boundary.labels_allowed: Future path/order/outcome labels only on label side.
feature_label_boundary.blocked: Future first-touch order, realized PnL, runtime winner/loser, and post-entry high/low cannot become features for the same decision.

split_boundary.policy: Validation may select within predeclared rules; OOS remains locked readout.

leakage_risk: M5 OHLC both-hit label can leak future path if reused as a pre-entry feature.
OOS F85 readout can leak if used to select F86 thresholds.
Timezone unresolved status can distort session features if directly treated as UTC.
boundary: Current sources are usable for M5 ambiguity/proxy design but insufficient for authoritative intrabar first-touch order.
